decisions.reason: The existing message-352 MODIFY already replaces INA219 with INA3221 in the standalone USB-powered rail description.
Replacing the 3.3V-rail current monitor does not change the 5V boost converter, its enable control, or its powered loads.
The existing message-352 MODIFY already records INA3221 as the current-monitor device, while both monitored rails remain unchanged.
The INA3221 selection does not alter the AXP2101 battery input or its role as the normal-operation power source.
The current interboard power-path description still names INA219 as the series monitor and must reflect its replacement by INA3221.

value_updates.sensor_board_three_volt_three_power_path: The 3.3V rail forwarded through J_SENSOR_PWR is downstream of the Schottky diodes and INA3221.

decisions.reason: The current LED requirement already uses the separate 5V supply path and is unaffected by replacing the 3.3V-rail current monitor.
The current-monitor substitution does not change the charge-status display or dedicated charge-LED interface.
The INA3221 selection does not change battery overcharge, overdischarge, short-circuit, or protection-component requirements.
The current-monitor substitution does not affect the battery NTC connection or AXP2101 thermal-protection behavior.
The source acceptance concerns the INA3221 current-monitor choice and does not establish a change to the LED daughterboard's part, count, form, or supply voltage.
The INA3221 selection does not resolve or alter the battery connector family, pin functions, part number, or unresolved pin order.
Adding INA3221 as an I2C current monitor does not necessarily change the established bus speed, pull-ups, series resistors, topology, or interboard route.
